record.question: Which state launches its first air ambulance for the public recently?
record.explanation: Answer A: Assam. Assam is the location of the 16 November 2017 launch at Guwahati by Transport Minister Chandra Mohan Patowary. The original on-site reporter identifies operator Flaps Aviation Private Limited and its Book Air Ambulance brand. This was not a state-owned free ambulance fleet. Historical/source note: Historical Guwahati-based public-access private service, inaugurated by an Assam minister. “Its first” is the local launch description, not proof of India’s first air ambulance or state ownership. Reference: https://www.sentinelassam.com/guwahati-today/minister-patowary-launches-air-ambulance-service. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
